CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_practice_task_publication (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_practice_task_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES student_practice_task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    share_slug varchar(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    visibility smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (visibility IN (0, 1, 2)),
    status smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (status IN (0, 1)),
    snapshot_storage_file_id uuid NOT NULL,
    snapshot_sha256 char(64) NOT NULL CHECK (snapshot_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    snapshot_manifest_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    security_report_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    task_snapshot_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    result_snapshot_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    published_at timestamptz NULL,
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT student_practice_task_publication_share_slug_format
        CHECK (share_slug ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32}$')
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_practice_task_publication_public_profile
    ON student_practice_task_publication(student_id, published_at DESC)
    WHERE status = 1 AND visibility = 2;
